title: Scottish Bubble and Squeak Patties
description: Mashed potatoes, cabbage, carrot, and cheese are made into convenient patties and fried. My father-in-law is from Scotland and this is a favorite family dish.
ingredients: 1 pound potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks

steps.text: Place potatoes into a saucepan and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer over medium heat until tender enough to pierce with a fork, about 10 minutes. Drain and mash potatoes, then set aside.

Meanwhile, combine cabbage and carrot in another saucepan and add just enough water to barely cover the bottom of the pan. Cook over medium heat until tender, about 5 minutes. Drain off liquid and stir into mashed potatoes along with onion, mustard, and Cheddar cheese. Season with salt and pepper.
Shape mixture into 4 patties. Heat a greased grill pan over medium-high heat. Place patties on the pan and grill until heated through and golden brown, about 5 minutes on each side. Serve right away.

video.description: A traditional dish loved throughout the United Kingdom, you'll be surprised at how utterly delicious this humble combination of potatoes, cabbage, and carrots can be! It's a great use of leftover mashed or baked potatoes, and if you don't want to fuss around with patties, you can combine all of the ingredients into a hash by pan-frying in a bit of oil. Topped with a fried egg it makes a comforting and easy weeknight supper!
video.name: Scottish Bubbles and Squeak Patties
